data.name: Fatihatun
data.gender_notes: Fatihatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'fathah', meaning 'opener' or 'opener of the heart'. In Islamic tradition, it is used to refer to the first chapter (surah) of the Quran. The name Fatihatun carries the meaning “The Opener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatihatun usually hope their child will grow to embody the opener and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatihatun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name symbolizes triumph, divine guidance, and the beginning of a new, blessed journey.
